title: unit-calibration/1
description: The unit's calibration file, calibration.yaml: the home table of its 25 drive slots and, per foot, the map from the two ankle motors to the foot's hinge angles. Angles in rad. Every object refuses a key that it does not list. The file is at most 262144 bytes (256 KiB) and is read with yaml.safe_load after a scan of its YAML tokens (the contract's acceptance sheet lists what the scan refuses); this schema applies to the document as loaded.

home_table.description: 25 rows in firmware slot order: row i is slot i, with that slot's actuator name. Per drive q = sign x r + home_rad, r the drive's reading from its stored zero, q the model file's angle of the slot's joint or, for an ankle motor, its coordinate in the firmware's ankle map.

ankle_map.description: Per foot: the model file's foot hinge angles, pitch (<side>_ankle_pitch_joint) and roll (<side>_ankle_roll_joint), in rad, as functions of the foot's two ankle motors' q, A and B (rad, the motors' coordinates under this file's home table). Nodes A_i = -0.787 + i x 1.574 / 18 (row index i) and B_j = -0.787 + j x 1.574 / 18 (column index j), i, j = 0 to 18; pitch[i][j] and roll[i][j] are the angles at (A_i, B_j). Between nodes the map is bilinear in A and B; outside the extent the bilinear formula of the nearest edge cell (its cell index clamped to 0 to 17) is extended.

not_nan.description: Refuses a NaN (YAML .nan), which minimum and maximum let through (every comparison with a NaN is false): the inner schema matches a NaN and no other value.

home_rad.description: q at the drive's stored zero (r = 0); finite, |home_rad| <= 6.3
home_rad.$comment: 6.3 rad: a bound just above one turn (2 pi = 6.283 rad)

axes.description: row index: motor A; column index: motor B

extent.description: fixed: A and B from -0.787 to 0.787 rad
extent.$comment: 0.787 rad = 2.02 x 0.35 + 0.8 x 0.10: the largest |A| or |B| of a command inside the firmware's ankle box (pitch 0.35 rad, roll 0.10 rad) under its map A = 2.02 pitch - 0.8 roll, B = -2.02 pitch - 0.8 roll

pitch.description: the foot's pitch hinge angle at each node, [i][j] = (A_i, B_j)

roll.description: the foot's roll hinge angle at each node, [i][j] = (A_i, B_j)
